opening.argument: The speaker offers a free $100 Nike gift card in exchange for clicking a claim button and completing a survey, while the description sends viewers to an external URL. He says the survey is connected to the card and may ask for age, Facebook usage, and an email for further details. That combination presents a low-barrier reward acquisition process involving personal information, not a plainly unconditional gift. The speaker also tells viewers to expect a mailed card after following emailed details, yet neither Nike's authorization nor the destination operator is verified. The promised reward and collection process therefore support treating the offer as deceptive promotional content, while the evidence does not establish actual losses or a completed delivery.
